arStrings.szText:
If no puddle is around you, {c_important}Pulverize{/c} forms a puddle that guarantees its own {c_important}{u}Overpowers{/u}{/c} and deals {c_number}[Affix_Value_1|%x|*100]{/c} of its normal damage as Poisoning over {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds. 

{c_important}Pulverizing{/c} causes all close puddles to splash {c_number}[Affix_Value_2|%x|*100]{/c} of their total damage within their areas and around them.
